title: Mathlib v4.30 Nat.bit binary-constructor family, kernel-lane

recipe.description: Author one s5-side Lean statement-adapter `def <name> : Prop := <the fact's formal.statement, verbatim>` per target in a single batch file, compile it once against pinned Mathlib v4.30.0, export each target with `lean4export`, import the proof-free statement stream into a fresh independent kernel (`import_statement_ndjson`, which refuses any proof-bearing or trusted declaration), and hand the resulting goal to the SHAPE-GENERIC producer `axeyum_lean_import::producers::bounded_induction::propose_bounded_induction`: peel the leading Pi/hypothesis telescope, try `Eq.refl` at the terminal, and where that is stuck attempt one bounded structural induction over a discovered zero/succ binder plus one congruence rewrite driven by the induction hypothesis. The producer never sees a theorem name and has no per-target arm: it decides only from the goal's own shape, and declines with a typed reason (`TerminalNotClosed`-class messages from the bounded chain, or a `StatementImportError` before it ever runs). That is what makes one recipe cover the family rather than one fact.

non_examples.reason: Same fragment (`Nat`), same `lean4-surface` language, same `Mathlib v4.30 source proposition` title family, and topically the nearest neighbour there is -- but its statement mentions `Nat.testBit`, and `Nat.bit` is not a substring of `Nat.testBit`. The distinction is load-bearing rather than cosmetic: `Nat.testBit` is divergence-blocked here (ours returns a `Nat`, Mathlib's a `Bool`, docs/research/11-design-review/2026-09-02-what-the-frontier-is-shaped-like.md), so a shape that swallowed it would be claiming capability over a proposition this project does not hold.

Same fragment, same language, same ml430 mirror population, and it is the LARGEST live sibling bucket on the frontier (`natural-binomial-bounds`, train partition, 10 open rows) -- deliberately named as the non-example because it is the bucket a size-ranked selector would have merged with this one. `Nat.choose n k <= 2 ^ n` contains no `Nat.bit`, and no bounded refl/induction chain closes an arithmetic bound: it needs a real inequality argument. The predicate discriminates by recipe, not by carrier.

notes:
Sized against the 2026-09-02 regeneration of artifacts/autogenesis/frontier-shape-census-v1.json (23 targetable of 257 ready). This shape matches ten facts, ALL of them `development` partition rows of draw 19's `natural-bit-constructor` family (ADR-1561, primary module `Mathlib.Data.Nat.BinaryRec`), none held-out, none an outcome-blind mutation fixture.

WHY THIS CONTRACT MATCHES NO TRAIN ROW, STATED RATHER THAN OMITTED. `scripts/check-development-partition.py` enforces that an OPERATION closing a development fact must also close a train fact, so a contract aimed only at development is a warning sign by construction. Measured 2026-09-02: the whole live train population is 17 open rows -- 5 outcome-blind mutation controls (FALSE by construction, must never be closed), 2 divergence-blocked (`Nat.fastFib`, `Squarefree`), and the 10 `natural-binomial-bounds` rows above. There is no train row this recipe can reach, because the only recipe-coherent train bucket in existence is the binomial bounds one, and a refl/bounded-induction chain does not prove `choose n k <= 2 ^ n`. The honest statement is therefore: this contract is development-only because the frontier offers no train sibling for this recipe, not because the producer was authored against the evaluation set -- `propose_bounded_induction` predates this lane (registered 2026-08-22 under `authoritative-mathlib-bounded-induction-factorial-family-v1`, sized against TRAIN facts) and was not modified by it. See ADR-1570.

This contract asserts only that the shape is dischargeable via `kernel-lane`; admission of any instance still requires an independently kernel-checked, axiom-free proof, per ADR-0602 SS1.

sizing.note: Measured 2026-09-02 by re-executing this contract's own shape predicate over artifacts/facts/, restricted to facts that are open, dependency-ready, NOT in a held-out nursery partition (read from every artifacts/autogenesis/nursery*.json, not just nursery-v1.json) and not an outcome-blind mutation fixture. Cross-checked against the independently produced shape census, whose coarse buckets rank this family's members 1/3/6/8/9/10 and mark all ten targetable.
